summary.text: Lisa Boscola is a Democratic state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 18 in the Lehigh Valley since 1998 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. She previously served two terms in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Boscola was born in Bethlehem on April 6, 1962, and describes herself as a steel worker's daughter and lifelong resident of the Lehigh Valley, according to her official biography.
She earned bachelor's and master's degrees from Villanova University and worked as Deputy Court Administrator with the Northampton County Court before running for office.
Boscola was first elected to the General Assembly in 1994, served two terms in the House, and is in her sixth term representing the 18th Senatorial District.
Her biography says she has worked to eliminate the local school property tax, to freeze property taxes on seniors, and to change the redistricting process through an independent citizens' commission.
She was the prime sponsor of Senate Bill 421 of 2019-20, which became Act 77 of 2019 and eliminated straight-party voting and created no-excuse mail-in voting.
